entries.title: Proverbs 26:1
segments: As snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, So honor is not seemly for a fool.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:2
segments: As the sparrow in her wandering, as the swallow in her flying, So the curse that is causeless alighteth not.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:3
segments: A whip for the horse, a bridle for the ass, And a rod for the back of fools.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:4
segments: Answer not a fool according to his folly, Lest thou also be like unto him.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:5
segments: Answer a fool according to his folly, Lest he be wise in his own conceit.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:6
segments: He that sendeth a message by the hand of a fool Cutteth off [his own] feet, [and] drinketh in damage.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:7
segments: The legs of the lame hang loose: So is a parable in the mouth of fools.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:8
segments: As one that bindeth a stone in a sling, So is he that giveth honor to a fool.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:9
segments: [As] a thorn that goeth up into the hand of a drunkard, So is a parable in the mouth of fools.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:10
segments: [As] an archer that woundeth all, So is he that hireth a fool and he that hireth them that pass by.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:11
segments: As a dog that returneth to his vomit, [So is] a fool that repeateth his folly.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:12
segments: Seest thou a man wise in his own conceit? There is more hope of a fool than of him.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:13
segments: The sluggard saith, There is a lion in the way; A lion is in the streets.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:14
segments: [As] the door turneth upon its hinges, So doth the sluggard upon his bed.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:15
segments: The sluggard burieth his hand in the dish; It wearieth him to bring it again to his mouth.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:16
segments: The sluggard is wiser in his own conceit Than seven men that can render a reason.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:17
segments: He that passeth by, [and] vexeth himself with strife belonging not to him, Is [like] one that taketh a dog by the ears.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:18
segments: As a madman who casteth firebrands, Arrows, and death,

entries.title: Proverbs 26:19
segments: So is the man that deceiveth his neighbor, And saith, Am not I in sport?

entries.title: Proverbs 26:20
segments: For lack of wood the fire goeth out; And where there is no whisperer, contention ceaseth.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:21
segments: [As] coals are to hot embers, and wood to fire, So is a contentious man to inflame strife.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:22
segments: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, And they go down into the innermost parts.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:23
segments: Fervent lips and a wicked heart Are [like] an earthen vessel overlaid with silver dross.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:24
segments: He that hateth dissembleth with his lips; But he layeth up deceit within him:

entries.title: Proverbs 26:25
segments: When he speaketh fair, believe him not; For there are seven abominations in his heart:

entries.title: Proverbs 26:26
segments: Though [his] hatred cover itself with guile, His wickedness shall be openly showed before the assembly.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:27
segments: Whoso diggeth a pit shall fall therein; And he that rolleth a stone, it shall return upon him.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:28
segments: A lying tongue hateth those whom it hath wounded; And a flattering mouth worketh ruin.
